title: #144 Environmental Challenges
prompt: Business and commercial organizations should help to solve environmental challenges. To what extent do you agree with this opinion?

promptSegments.text: Business and commercial organizations should help to solve environmental challenges.
To what extent do you agree with this opinion?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

modelPlan.focus: To address the prompt, the essay will argue that business and commercial organizations have a significant role in solving environmental challenges, supported by the provided vocabulary.
keyArguments: Business and commercial organizations can reduce their environmental impact through sustainable practices and resource management.
Implementing green initiatives and adhering to ESG criteria can mitigate environmental issues and promote corporate social responsibility.
